name: Guadalajara
summary: Guadalajara, known as “Mexican Silicon Valley,” combines a booming tech and startup scene with the culture that gave rise to tequila and mariachi. The coworking and young atmosphere of the Colonia Americana neighborhood attract a growing nomadic community, with a mild climate thanks to its altitude (1,566 m) and a low cost of living compared to the US or Europe. The trade-off is a perceived lower security than other nomadic hubs and a rainy season (June-September) with intense storms in the afternoons.
